accepted_scope_rows.ScopeItemStatement: Record each examination against an identified candidate, harness/model/server configuration and date.
Distinguish verification from practitioner validation and record passed, failed, blocked, not-run and inconclusive outcomes.
Test seams with recorded real protocol exchanges where possible and keep live-model runs few and deliberate.
Reopen affected scenarios when candidate code changes instead of reusing earlier passes as current evidence.
Examine interfaces in the macOS WebKit environment and smoke-check packaged target applications.
Protect examination criteria during repair; fix failures without weakening the criterion.
Independently review identified candidates, using a different model family where available.
